text:
Maya C: Heads-up — prepping KiteBridge QBR deck. Saw a big embedders spike yesterday, want a quick triage here.
AJ R: saw it too. ~3.2x embed requests between 02:00-06:00 PT. Likely a batch job.
Sophia L: are they on retainer or pay-as-you-go? that affects recommended mitigations.
Maya C: they're on monthly credits + a small overage allowance. Renewal in 6 weeks — want to avoid a surprise.
Glen T: action items: 1) confirm source of spike 2) propose throttle/credit buffer 3) schedule enablement w/ best practices.
AJ R: i'll ping their engineering contact (kate@kitebridge) — suspect a nightly analytics job.
Maya C: can we get a quick forecast for next 30 days if spike repeats? Sophia, any quick model?
Sophia L: posting a micro-forecast:
```
Assumptions: baseline 120k embed units/day, spike nights x3 for 4h, retention unchanged
Projected 30d spend (no change): $28.4k
If spikes persist 10/30 nights: $45.7k
Recommended safety buffer: +20% (~$9k)
```
AJ R: propose two mitigation options for QBR slides: A) apply temporary rate-limit on embed route for non-critical tokens; B) add a one-month credit buffer / retainer.
Maya C: +1 on presenting both. also capture feedback: their onboarding docs don't call out recommended batch/window patterns. we should include a short enablement session.
Glen T: i'll add a bullet for enablement: "Embed batching + TTLs + cache" and offer a 30-min runbook review.
Maya C: can alert-bot create a spend alert at 80% of current quota and an email escalation to Kate + CS team?
alert-bot: created alert: kitebridge-usage-80pct, triggers: email(group:customer-success@redwood) + webhook to #customer-success, threshold: 80% of monthly credits.
Sophia L: noted for QBR financials — i'll show base vs worst-case waterfall and a recommended retainer size.
AJ R: i'll update the account notes with the suspected nightly job and ping Kate.
Maya C: thanks team — i'll draft the QBR slide and assign owners. quick ask: anyone can own follow-up with Kate before EOD?
AJ R: on it, will update when i hear back. :thumbsup:
